["table","alert_rules","alert_rules","CREATE TABLE alert_rules (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('total_value_target', 'asset_value_target', 'asset_price_target', 'asset_price_move', 'allocation_deviation', 'period_pnl', 'portfolio_value_change')),\n  asset_type TEXT CHECK (asset_type IS NULL OR asset_type IN ('crypto', 'stock')),\n  symbol TEXT,\n  comparator TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (comparator IN ('gte', 'lte')),\n  threshold REAL NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('asset_price_move', 'period_pnl', 'portfolio_value_change') OR threshold >= 0),\n  window TEXT CHECK (window IS NULL OR window IN ('24h', '7d', '30d')),\n  enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (enabled IN (0, 1)),\n  cooldown_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3600 CHECK (cooldown_seconds >= 0),\n  last_triggered_at TEXT,\n  last_value REAL,\n  armed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (armed IN (0, 1)),\n  CHECK (\n    (kind IN ('asset_value_target', 'asset_price_target', 'asset_price_move', 'allocation_deviation')) =\n    (asset_type IS NOT NULL AND symbol IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(symbol)) > 0)\n  ),\n  CHECK (\n    (kind IN ('asset_price_move', 'period_pnl', 'portfolio_value_change')) =\n    (window IS NOT NULL)\n  )\n)"]

["table","currency_rates","currency_rates","CREATE TABLE \"currency_rates\" (\n\tid INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT UNIQUE,\n\tcurrency TEXT NOT NULL,\n\talias TEXT NOT NULL,\n\tsymbol TEXT NOT NULL,\n\trate REAL NOT NULL, -- rate based on usd\n\tpriority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n\tupdatedAt DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n)"]
["table","history_snapshots","history_snapshots","CREATE TABLE history_snapshots (\n  uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,\n  createdAt TEXT NOT NULL\n)"]
["trigger","history_snapshots_delete","assets_v2","CREATE TRIGGER history_snapshots_delete\nAFTER DELETE ON assets_v2\nBEGIN\n  DELETE FROM history_snapshots WHERE uuid = OLD.uuid\n    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assets_v2 WHERE uuid = OLD.uuid);\n  UPDATE history_snapshots SET createdAt =\n    (SELECT MAX(createdAt) FROM assets_v2 WHERE uuid = OLD.uuid)\n    WHERE uuid = OLD.uuid AND createdAt = OLD.createdAt\n      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assets_v2 WHERE uuid = OLD.uuid AND createdAt = OLD.createdAt);\nEND"]
["trigger","history_snapshots_insert","assets_v2","CREATE TRIGGER history_snapshots_insert\nAFTER INSERT ON assets_v2\nBEGIN\n  INSERT INTO history_snapshots (uuid, createdAt) VALUES (NEW.uuid, NEW.createdAt)\n  ON CONFLICT(uuid) DO UPDATE SET createdAt =\n    CASE WHEN excluded.createdAt < history_snapshots.createdAt\n      THEN (SELECT MAX(createdAt) FROM assets_v2 WHERE uuid = excluded.uuid)\n      ELSE excluded.createdAt END;\nEND"]
["index","history_snapshots_time_idx","history_snapshots","CREATE INDEX history_snapshots_time_idx ON history_snapshots (createdAt DESC, uuid DESC)"]
["trigger","history_snapshots_update","assets_v2","CREATE TRIGGER history_snapshots_update\nAFTER UPDATE OF uuid, createdAt ON assets_v2\nBEGIN\n  DELETE FROM history_snapshots WHERE uuid = OLD.uuid\n    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assets_v2 WHERE uuid = OLD.uuid);\n  UPDATE history_snapshots SET createdAt =\n    (SELECT MAX(createdAt) FROM assets_v2 WHERE uuid = OLD.uuid)\n    WHERE uuid = OLD.uuid AND createdAt = OLD.createdAt\n      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assets_v2 WHERE uuid = OLD.uuid AND createdAt = OLD.createdAt);\n  INSERT INTO history_snapshots (uuid, createdAt) VALUES (NEW.uuid, NEW.createdAt)\n  ON CONFLICT(uuid) DO UPDATE SET createdAt =\n    CASE WHEN excluded.createdAt < history_snapshots.createdAt\n      THEN (SELECT MAX(createdAt) FROM assets_v2 WHERE uuid = excluded.uuid)\n      ELSE excluded.createdAt END;\nEND"]
